notes.title: Compatibility Update : Patch 1
notes.content:
Daniel here,

I've been up nonstop trying to figure out how to get other headsets to be compatible. Currently setting a default config has been problematic, but will be resolved as soon as I possibly can get a proper action manifest file setup. With this said, if you are on Index there is a [b]temporary fix! [/b]

One of our testers,[b] Quadstrike[/b], has setup [b]a bindings preset for Index that can be copied[/b]. If you're on Index and controls are not working, find and copy his binds through the Index Controller Bind Settings.

In other notes, for other headsets apparently the hand position was off, so I updated to the OpenXR standard plugin and readjusted. Still need to test if this works for headsets beyond Quest / Oculus Systems. 

[b]Other updates include :[/b]
- AI no longer "tweak out" in a weird rotation
- Breakinator pickaxe tips work to break items
- Physics force increased for the amount force needed to deal damage
- UI Settings button fix

Final note, I am going to be trying to do a Weekly update / patch for these compatibility problems until they are fixed. I want to thank you all for your patience, as the core dev with only a Quest 2 it's hard to solve these things without getting hands on with the headsets. With that said, if you would like to help with configuring your type of headset [b]join our discord![/b] We run rounds of testing and bug finding over there. 

All the best,
- DLC

notes.title: RuinWaker Demo is now LIVE!!!
notes.content:
Welcome ARCHES Members to RUINWAKER!

In the demo you will get a taste of the features we've added so far. Have the freedom to [b]Blast[/b] enemies, [b]Climb[/b] over obstacles, and [b]Discover[/b] lost wonders! 

Explore the Test Room as well with the Weapon Range! More will be added soon to the demo as we fix bugs and add more features. Keep an eye out for our next post outlining RUINWAKER's milestones as we progress into 2023.  

We hope everyone had a good holiday and a happy New Year!
- The DarkCrest Team

notes.title: Welcome A.R.C.H.E.S. Travelers!
notes.content:
[b]Hello and Welcome ARCHES Travelers![/b]

We've got some good news coming! The first alpha demo build will be playable very soon! 

Unfortunately there's also some bad news : there's currently a bug so that only Oculus headsets have full functionality, but we wanted to get the demo out so at least Oculus users could get their hands on RuinWaker. We are actively working to fix the problem so Index users can also play, with expansion to more headsets in the future! 

The last thing we are waiting for is the final checks through Steam, and then we'll be launching!

With this said, the DarkCrest team wishes you all a [b]Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays![/b]

- Daniel Cardona ( AKA - DLC )
